status: mixed E1/E3; every entry declares its own evidence level

signed_rank_one.interpretation: Pre-lift exact leverage compression is sharp. The smooth trace-square parallel version has overhead below two; the adaptive trace-square selector also has overhead below two.

regular_simplex.interpretation: Childwise scalarization loses exactly m(m-2)^2. The parent Schur complement suppresses the simple-null direction. The smooth trace-square parallel version has overhead below four, while the adaptive selector has overhead exactly two.

rank_one_shallow_determinant_tail.evidence_level: E3 algebraic proof draft plus E3 finite rational recurrence checks for 4<=m<=12
rank_one_shallow_determinant_tail.consequence: Every fixed-depth or r=o(m) determinant-tail hierarchy has c_r/mu -> 0; Omega(m) depth is necessary.

signed_rank_one_half_depth_all_mu.transverse_bound: prefix energy >= number of selected distinguished coordinates, hence h_perp>=r/n>=1/2
signed_rank_one_half_depth_all_mu.consequence: H_half >= (mu/2)B^-1 for every n>=2 and 0<mu<=1 on the signed-rank-one family.

disjoint_signed_rank_one_blocks.local_prefix_limit: (2s-1-1/k)/(k-1) after s>=1 coordinates from a size-k block
disjoint_signed_rank_one_blocks.consequence: liminf_{mu->0} c_{ceil(n/2)}(A_mu)/mu>=1/2 for every such block union; this is structured, not universal.

first_moment_kernel_rotation.consequence: No finite universal scalar C can satisfy R_B <= C bar(D)_B. The basis must admit new directions at second level.

regular_simplex_R_not_below_first.consequence: Even the coefficient-one monotone guess R_B<=bar(D)_B is false.

n3_H1_barrier_and_H2_gain.interpretation: The exact second moment closes dimension three and strictly clears the former H1 obstruction; this does not establish an all-dimensional result.

two_step_scalar_chain_failure.interpretation: The sharp two-step scalar lower bound is valid locally but loses the anisotropy needed for a third Bellman step.

kadison_rank_one_barrier.consequence: K >= (E M_pi^{-1})^T(E M_pi^{-1}) cannot yield c*mu with a universal positive c. The discarded variance is essential.

global_one_step_constant_upper_bound.family_lower_bound: Writing z=mu^(2n), the parallel ratio is S_n/n+(1-z)/[mu(1+mu)] >= 1/[mu(1+mu)]+z/[mu^2(1+mu)] > 1/2; every transverse ratio is at least 1 from two distinguished solve entries.
global_one_step_constant_upper_bound.consequence: This family has exact infimum 1/2. No universal global one-step A-energy constant c>1/2 is possible; the surviving half-depth c=1/2 candidate is asymptotically optimal if true.

bare_jensen_rank_one_barrier.consequence: Bare Jensen cannot establish any universal positive c; variance/Bellman information is necessary.

half_depth_determinant_tail.warning: No violation is not a proof.

rank_one_half_depth_large_n.evidence_level: E1 float64 grid minimization of an algebraically exact two-scalar recurrence
rank_one_half_depth_large_n.interpretation: The half-depth constant approaches 1/2 from above on this family, so 1/2 is the plausible sharp universal constant if the half-depth conjecture is true.
rank_one_half_depth_large_n.warning: Grid minimization and asymptotic pattern are not a proof.

parallel_compression.warning: The PSD inequality is proved algebraically; these figures test implementation only.
